question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

ABCD, CTFZ, ELIV, GDLR, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​

 
• First letter → (2) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (8) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (3) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter → (4) is subtracted from the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c0a369c84afdcd406a14f2d692e02f04fe83c38aeb0734defa4056074db1f06.png] 

Hence, "IVON" is the correct answer.

9d
